decision: Hugging Face MasakhaNER-X JSONL is the primary candidate source of record. The GitHub MasakhaNER2.0/sna CoNLL corpus is retained as a documented alternative.

verified_upstream_source.note: The HF repository holds only the card and loader; the loader fetches the JSONL from the GitHub path on the moving 'main' branch. We pin to the commit above for reproducibility.

conclusion.conditions: Retain attribution to Masakhane / Adelani et al. (2022), include the licence notice and link, and indicate any modifications.
conclusion.caveat: HTTP 200 / a pinned URL does NOT establish permission. Permission derives from the licence terms above only. A final written confirmation from the Masakhane rights holders is advisable before any redistribution.

recommended_next_action: Obtain explicit human confirmation that the intended DARE use is strictly non-commercial, then (and only then) download the three pinned JSONL files and run scripts/inspect_dataset.py --validate on them. Do not redistribute raw underlying news text without reviewing per-site licences.
